spots.line: A muster board covers the far wall, ruled for four hundred names.
The candles have been lit and relit so long the sconces have grown stalactites.

chests.line: A pay chest, sealed the season the pay stopped coming.

people.name: a knight standing his watch
chatter: Ser Valis will not have the muster rolls moved. So they stay where they are.
Do not look the old one in the eye for long. It is a courtesy to yourself.

people.name: a wisp that followed you in
chatter: It has been drifting behind you since the gate and nobody else has remarked on it.
